messages:
sam: Heads-up — Granite customer private/VPC deploy scheduled for 2025-03-29 02:00 UTC (1h window). Who's owning the deploy and smoke?
elaine: I can lead the deploy. I’ll be on standby from 01:30 UTC for prechecks.
raj: I’ll do infra handoff and rollback readiness. Confirming reserved capacity and routing rules.
maria: I’ll run the smoke scripts and monitor logs during the window. Post-deploy sanity checks + perf.
devon: I’ll shadow for canary routing and metrics, and stay on pager if anything weird pops.
ops-bot: Maintenance window created: Granite VPC — 2025-03-29 02:00:00 UTC to 2025-03-29 03:00:00 UTC — ticket #GV-4521
sam: Great. Quick checklist:
- who triggers deploy (elaine)
- canary size: 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%
- smoke tests (maria)
- rollback plan (raj)
- post-deploy perf/latency check (devon)
elaine: Confirming I trigger and monitor. Will follow the canary plan.
raj: Rollback plan: snapshot current NodeGroup, re-route traffic to previous model variant, and rollback cloud route table if needed. Steps:
```
1) run terraform apply -target=module.route_table
2) rollback image in k8s: kubectl set image deployment/granite-api granite=granite:v2025-03-28
3) monitor errors /metrics for 10m
```
raj: I’ll keep the previous AMI and network controls pinned until we get +30m healthy.
maria: Smoke script I’ll run (quick):
```bash
TOKEN=$SVC_TOKEN
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://granite.private.redwood/api/health | jq .status
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"sanity"}' https://granite.private.redwood/api/generate | jq .choices[0].text
```
maria: If health != "ok" or generate latency > 800ms -> fail and signal rollback.
devon: I’ll keep a dashboard open for p99 latency, error rate, and token CPU. I will post flags if p99 > 1s for >2min.
sam: Client success contact is Lisa. She’s on standby and will do acceptance tests after we hit 100%.
elaine: ETA for preflight checks: I’ll run them 2025-03-29 01:35 UTC. Will post results here.
ops-bot: Preflight checklist reminder — run network checks, confirm KMS access, verify audit logging.
raj: One more: ensure KV cache priming for common prefixes before canary. I’ll kick off a priming job at 01:45 UTC.
maria: Noted. I’ll validate cache hit rate during canary.
devon: Small ask — if anything requires immediate rollback, send a single-line `/rollback now` message here and raj + elaine will act. No long threads.
sam: Agreed.
elaine: Preflight done 01:46 UTC — all green except one stale cert on a sidecar (fixed).
maria: Smoke run 02:10 UTC on 10% canary — health ok, avg gen latency 320ms, p99 650ms.
devon: Metrics look stable. No error spikes. Proceeding to 50% at 02:26 UTC.
maria: 50% green. No regressions.
ops-bot: Deployment complete — canary -> 100% at 02:40 UTC.
elaine: 100% deployed at 02:41 UTC. Maria, start acceptance tests with Lisa.
maria: Acceptance tests passing. Client confirms basic flows + data retention checks.
raj: Holding previous NodeGroup for 30m post-100% then will deprecate.
sam: Thanks everyone. Closing the window after 03:10 UTC if no issues. :thumbsup:
